title: spec(field): retire the `@deprecated` `CurrencyValueSchema` (still exported at `field.zod.ts:581`) — ADR-0104 D1 says deleted; prerequisite of the multi-currency epic #8345
body:
Filing gate ③ (maintainer-directed). Ruling 6465431966 on #27119 (batch #421 item 2, Q1 = 乙-现在, maintainer 「同意立专题卡」 2026-10-28): the multi-currency epic resumes on #8345 in shape C′. Part of #8345. Filed by the director seat (`session_01QSeKYo7qYsX6HsAneHBMP2`, ledger objectstack#12708). ⛔ Not a claim. Workload row and precedents: 6464936321; design: 6464438764.

Ruling-ref: 6465431966

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 删掉 `field.zod.ts:581` 仍导出的 `CurrencyValueSchema` 与 `CurrencyValue` 类型（L3062），tombstone 进 `UNKNOWN_KEY_GUIDANCE`。
- **为什么改：** ADR-0104 D1 裁定它「已删除」，18.2.0 里它还在；多币种开工前必须先清掉，否则 AI 作者会把它当成「记录币种」的形状。
- **风险与回滚：** 纯退役，零读者（ADR-0104 自述 never consumed）；回滚 = 还原导出。
- **先看：** `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts:575–600`。
- **两分钟验证：** `git grep -n CurrencyValueSchema -- packages` → 只剩 tombstone。
- **需要您做的：** 无。

## Task

- [ ] Delete the schema and the type; tombstone with the FROM → TO note (a currency value is a bare number).
- [ ] The `spec-property-retirement` kit as applicable (liveness ledger line, baselines, pin test).
- [ ] ADR-0104 currency paragraph: dated note that the deletion landed in PR #N.

Lane: spec · Size: XS · Review: default; spec seat. `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` · `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` (an export removed; no authorable key changes) · `Skills-docs: none — REASON: no authoring surface`.

Epic: #8345 (parent; the epic PM dispatches `pm:epic` children; `domain:spec` children go to the spec seat's queue). Dedupe: #8345 thread, #27119 (ruled), the workload list 6464936321; no open card carries this slice.
